Lena: Hey team, first day! I accepted the GitHub org invite but I still see 'Pending member' on the org page. I need access to private repo 'product-playbooks' for my onboarding tasks. Any suggestions?

Micah (People Ops): Welcome @Lena! Check if you accepted the invite with the same GitHub account that has your work email. Also confirm 2FA is enabled on that account.

Lena: I think I used my personal account by mistake. How can I tell which account accepted?

Ravi (EngAdmin): From the org settings we can see the pending invites. If you open the invite link it shows the username. Alternatively, run `gh auth status` to see which account gh is using.

Lena: gh auth status shows I'm logged in as lena-personal. The invite email went to lena@redwood.com.

onboard-bot: [system] Created ticket #211: "Org invite accepted by wrong account (Lena)". Assigned to EngAdmin.

Ravi (EngAdmin): We can resend the invite to lena-personal or to a new account. If you want to keep personal separate, create/sign into a GitHub account for your work email and I'll resend. Which do you prefer?

Lena: I want to use a work account. I just created lena-rw. Can you resend to lena-rw?

Ravi (EngAdmin): Resent invite to lena-rw. Reminder: enable 2FA (https://github.com/settings/security) and accept SSO from https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference after accepting the invite.

Lena: Accepted invite on lena-rw, did SSO and enabled 2FA. When I try `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/product-playbooks.git` I get permission denied (publickey).

Ravi (EngAdmin): Add your SSH key to lena-rw at https://github.com/settings/ssh/new. If you need a quick test, try `ssh -T git@github.com` to confirm identity.

Lena: Added key, `ssh -T` responded: "Hi lena-rw! You've successfully authenticated..." Clone now works. Thank you!

Micah (People Ops): Great, we've auto-added lena-rw to eng-new-hires. You'll also get membership to product-team after 1:1 sync. Welcome! :tada:
